name: Rest spends one Supply and enforces recovery value
Rest without Supply wounds five points before recovery
Healing recovers owned Wounds only, within value
upgrades use leftover budget, Diamonds double, Fate buys three points
paid no-Supply Rest can resume after reload without a second wound
no-Supply Rest resumes through menu and persisted cancellation starts a fresh Rest
numeric overflow is blocked for resource increments and Fate upgrades
each completed Rest advances Round once and Undo restores cards, Supply and Round
no-Supply Rest advances Round only after recovery; cancellation and fatal wounds do not
Rest confirmation Cancel/Escape do not alter cards, Supply, Round, log or Undo history
no-Supply Rest requires confirmation before wounds and retains default recovery value five
Heal defaults to five and Use item sits to the right of Healing value
selecting an item changes only Heal presentation; confirmation consumes exactly one item with no Coin change
cancelled Heal, picker cancellation, invalid healing and reload never consume the chosen item
empty inventory picker is recoverable; Heal without an item remains available
changed or removed inventory selection cannot consume a different item during Heal
Fix validates cost and funds; Cancel is inert; payment, four points and enablement commit together and Undo restores them
repair supports armor and zero cost, persists through reload/export and never pays twice
Card Zones colors are derived from nonempty Wounds/Fatigue and update after healing/rest/Undo
Rest completes once per cleared level using existing Supply and Round rules
opening Upgrade from the action button flashes unused points
repeated action selection closes an unstarted Challenge Wound Heal or Upgrade
repeated Rest selection closes the open unstarted Rest without another confirmation
selecting cards for Heal prevents action-button closing or switching
